about_the_game:
It is Free to Play.

Clicker Ore is an idle/clicker mining game where you battle increasing heat as you dig deeper. The deeper you go, the harder the ores become, your mining power decreases, and you must upgrade your equipment to survive. Upgrade your heat suit, unlock special pickaxes, develop your skills, and push your limits.

Pickaxes and Progression
Unlock new pickaxes, use passive abilities, and create your own playstyle. Progress continuously by auto-mining beyond your first pickaxe.

Heat Mechanics
As you descend deeper, heat increases and your mining power decreases. Return to the safe upper layers to earn gold, or upgrade your heat suit to venture into lower levels.

Quests and Prestige
The quest system continuously refreshes and offers rewards based on your progress. Gain permanent boosts through prestige, becoming stronger with each reset.

Boss Dungeons
Enter dungeons with keys, defeat bosses, and collect valuable loot. Short but intense battles await you.

Skills and Pets
Develop active skills to create powerful combinations. Pet creatures significantly increase your mining power.

Progress and Competition
Track your development with offline earnings, automated systems, and detailed statistics. Compete through achievements and global leaderboards.

Economy and Gameplay

The game is completely free to play. If you wish, you can speed up your progress by purchasing diamonds, dungeon keys, and cosmetic items. Pets can be purchased with diamonds.

Gameplay Loop

Mine, descend, manage heat, complete quests, upgrade your equipment, defeat bosses, gain permanent power through prestige, and make your mark on the leaderboards.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3) or Intel Core i5 (2018 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1/M2/M3) or Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

name: Clicker Ore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 630 / AMD Vega) or dedicated GPU equivalent to NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Descend into the depths of the earth, survive against rising heat, discover unique pickaxes, battle dungeon bosses, and become the master of the depths. The game will launch as Free to Play.
